stemMd: A population is modeled by $P(t)=480(1.07)^t$. Which statement describes the model?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The population increases by 7 individuals per time unit.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The population doubles every 7 time units.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The population increases by 7 percent for each one-unit increase in t.

explanationMd: The multiplier for a one-unit increase in t is 1.07=1+0.07. Thus the modeled increase is 7 percent of the current amount each time unit, starting from 480.

distractorRationale.b: The growth factor does not imply that doubling interval.
distractorRationale.a: The model uses a multiplicative percentage, not a fixed increment.
distractorRationale.d: The initial value is P(0)=480, whereas 1.07 is the growth multiplier.
